title: In Vitro Transcription for dgRNA
author: Amy Lyden
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.3bpgimn
materials: Make all reagents are at room temperature. Prepare the reaction mixtures below in the order specified. DO NOT prepare the reaction on ice, as some components are prone to precipitation.
Prepare tracrRNA mixture by adding the following reagents to a 1.5mL tube in order. tracrRNA template (90nt) IDT Nuclease-free water Ambion Catalog #AM9932
Prepare crRNA mixture by adding the following reagents to a 1.5mL tube in order. crRNA template (60nt) IDT Nuclease-free water Ambion Catalog #AM9932
Anneal tracrRNA template + T7 primer and crRNA template + T7 primer by heating to 95 °C on a heat block or thermocycler for 00:02:00 and allowing them to cool to room temperature slowly on the bench
Nanodrop or Qubit your tracrRNA template and crRNA template using ssDNA setting or kit. NanoDrop spectrophotometer Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #ND-1000
Equilibrate SPRI beads to room temperature.
Wait 00:01:00 then remove and discard the ethanol.
Using the HS RNA Qubit kit, quantify 1µL of the eluted tracrRNA and 1µL of the eluted crRNA. Follow standard HS RNA Qubit protocol. Qubit RNA HS Assay Kit Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #Q32852

steps.title: Prepare crRNA pool
steps.instruction: Order 96‑well plates of 96 crRNA templates from IDT, each oligo diluted in water to 10 µM (60 nt). Pool the crRNAs in equimolar amounts.

steps.title: Add T7 primer to crRNA pool
steps.instruction: Reconstitute the T7 transcription primer (18 nt, IDT) to 10 µM. Mix 500 µL of the 10 µM crRNA pool with 500 µL of the 10 µM T7 primer to obtain an equimolar mixture.

steps.title: Prepare tracrRNA and add T7 primer
steps.instruction: Reconstitute tracrRNA template (90 nt, IDT) to 100 µM. Reconstitute the T7 transcription primer (18 nt, IDT) to 100 µM. Mix 500 µL of the 100 µM tracrRNA with 500 µL of the 100 µM T7 primer to obtain an equimolar mixture.

steps.title: Dilute RNA‑T7 mixtures
steps.instruction: Dilute the tracrRNA‑T7 mixture with water to a final concentration of 800 ng/µL. Dilute the crRNA‑T7 mixture with water to a final concentration of 40 ng/µL. Aliquot and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare NTP mix
steps.instruction: Combine 200 µL each of ATP, CTP, GTP, and UTP (all 100 mM; Thermo Fisher Scientific catalog #R0481) to obtain a mixed NTP solution of 25 mM each.

steps.title: Prepare 1X T7 buffer and enzyme
steps.instruction: Dilute 10X T7 buffer (400 mM Tris pH 7.9, 200 mM MgCl₂, 50 mM DTT, 20 mM spermidine; Sigma 85558) to 1X (prepare 200 µL for the reaction). Dilute T7 enzyme (10 mg/mL, contributed by users) to 100 µg/mL in the 1X T7 buffer. Store the 10X buffer at –80 °C.

steps.title: In‑vitro transcription
steps.instruction: Combine the diluted crRNA‑T7 and/or tracrRNA‑T7 mixtures with the NTP mix and 1X T7 buffer, add T7 enzyme, and incubate at 37 °C for 2 h. Proceed immediately to purification.

steps.title: Purify RNA with SPRI beads
steps.instruction: Purify the transcribed gRNAs using homemade SPRI beads or Ampure XP beads (alternatively Zymo RNA Clean & Concentrator‑5/‑25).

substeps.instruction: For each 200 µL IVT reaction, add 300 µL 100 % ethanol; the solution should become cloudy white.
For each 500 µL of the IVT‑ethanol mixture, add 500 µL SPRI beads and mix well by inverting or pipetting with a P1000.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 min.
Transfer the mixture to 1.5 mL Lo‑Bind tubes (or 15 mL tubes) and place on a magnetic rack appropriate for the tube size.
Allow beads to separate: wait 5 min for a 1.5 mL rack or 15 min for a 15 mL rack.
Rinse beads with 1 mL 80 % ethanol (1.5 mL tube) or ~10 mL 80 % ethanol (15 mL tube); do not resuspend beads.
Repeat the ethanol wash, wait 1 min, then discard the ethanol.
Remove residual ethanol from the tube bottom using a P200 or P20 pipette.
Air‑dry beads until matte: 5 min (1.5 mL tube) or 15 min (15 mL tube); avoid over‑drying.
Elute RNA by adding nuclease‑free H₂O: for DASH guides (final 40 µM) use ~80 µL per 1X reaction; for FLASH guides (final 4 µM) use a larger volume.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 min to allow elution.
If needed, pulse‑spin the tubes to collect liquid on the sides.
Place tubes back on the magnetic rack and wait until the water is clear (2‑5 min for 1.5 mL tube, 5‑10 min for 15 mL tube).
Collect the eluate, avoiding beads (e.g., from an 80 µL eluate collect ~75 µL).

steps.title: Dilute crRNA and tracrRNA stocks
steps.instruction: For DASH, dilute crRNA to 1100 ng/µL (80 µM) and tracrRNA to 1900 ng/µL (80 µM). For FLASH or lower‑concentration applications, dilute crRNA to 110 ng/µL (8 µM) and tracrRNA to 190 ng/µL (8 µM).

steps.title: Optional RNA quality check
steps.instruction: Prepare 1:100 dilutions of crRNA and tracrRNA, denature by heating to 95 °C for 3 min, then run on an Agilent Small RNA Bioanalyzer chip (catalog #5067‑1548). crRNA is 42 nt; tracrRNA is 72 nt.

steps.title: Assemble dgRNA complex
steps.instruction: Mix equal volumes of the 80 µM crRNA stock and the 80 µM tracrRNA stock (equimolar amounts). Heat the mixture to 95 °C for 30 s, then allow it to cool slowly on the bench to form the dgRNA complex.

steps.title: Store dgRNA aliquots
steps.instruction: Aliquot the dgRNA complex and store at –80 °C to avoid freeze‑thaw cycles. Unused crRNA or tracrRNA can be frozen separately; the dgRNA complex can be re‑formed immediately before Cas9 complexing by repeating the 95 °C 30 s heat step.
